label: Wallet: the mark-up on the portal's keys, the daily cap and when to warn
description_nl: 2026-09-28 owner: managed credits - teachers and kids never make an API key. The portal owner adds credit by hand (the person pays by UPI or bank); every key the owner lends through the wallet draws on ONE balance. markup_pct: added to what each run really cost. day_cap_usd: the most one person may be charged in a day (0 = no cap; the owner can change it per person). low_at_usd: warn when this much is left. add_max_usd: the largest single top-up. Refunds: a picture the check threw away and drew again is never charged - the portal pays for its own mistakes.
